title: Chinese researchers hail breakthrough in DRAM-like cells which could be used in embedded or 3D stacked memory; absence of manufacturing detail casts doubt on mass production
supports: IMECAS dual-gate IGZO 2T0C: vertical word-line structure, write and read transistors share a storage node, 4F2 cell; sidewall stack patterned in one litho + etch step (self-aligned single-step, SASS); manufacturing detail limited (via search snippet; resp-and-stack WebSearch 1/2). Used in the RT-PROC-and-stack-01 response: a multi-tier shared-node 2T0C exists, but in a vertical-word-line topology, not a single-film AND hole.

title: IME CAS + Beijing Super String: highly stackable 3D DRAM of dual-gate IGZO 2T0C, record 3 b/cell, 400 s (VLSI 2026)
supports: Four-layer 3D 2T0C built with a single-step high-stack integration scheme; paper title 'Highly stackable 3D DRAM of Dual-gate IGZO 2T0C with Record 3 bits/cell and 400s Data Retention' accepted to VLSI 2026 (via search snippet, Chinese; resp-and-stack WebSearch 1/2)

title: Vertical dual-gate IGZO 2T0C 3D DRAM (Nature Communications, Dec 2025, same group per snippet)

title: Macronix proposes 3D to breathe life back into NOR flash (IEDM 2020)
supports: Macronix vertical AND/NOR cell: holes through oxide/nitride; inside each hole two N+ doped poly plugs act as source and drain, separated by a SiN insulator column; remainder of the poly plug is a split channel; initial 8-layer structure, 34-layer stack 'appears viable'; hole diameter not given (via search snippet; resp-and-stack WebSearch 2/2). Used in RT-PROC-and-stack-03 response: twin S/D plugs in one hole exist at 8-34 layers, in doped poly.
